beliefs: f applies a uniform +4 ASCII shift to every character, including letters, digits, punctuation, space, and high characters [E1, E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7, E8]
Lowercase letters cross into punctuation: w->{, x->|, y->}, z->~ [E5, E8]
Uppercase letters cross into punctuation: W->[, X->\, Y->], Z->^ [E2, E3, E4, E8]
Space becomes $ and punctuation shifts by +4 (e.g. !->%, ~->\u0082) [E2, E3, E4, E6, E7, E8]
Characters near DEL shift past it: \u007f->\u0083, \u0080->\u0084, \u0081->\u0085 [E6, E7, E8]
No wrapping or clamping occurs at any boundary; the shift is unbounded [E7, E8]
notes: Shift is +4, not +2: E8's 'abc'->'cfg', 'ABC'->'CFG', '0123'->'4567', ' !~'->'$%\u0082' all confirm +4 uniformly. Updated predict to add 4.
